verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes machine-readable OpenAPI specs for Domains v1/v2/v3 and the Commerce APIs, plus copy-paste runnable examples (curl availability check, an end-to-end workflow in curl/Node/Python/Go). Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser explorer where calls can be run against the API, so 'runnable' here means copy-and-execute snippets rather than an interactive reference. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or API explorer, in-page execution of examples with your own token, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
